architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. CSS modules for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management lib; useContext + useReducer for global state. Ponytail: global state ceiling 500 LOC, add Redux if exceed. Tailwind CSS for utility classes. Mobile-first responsive design.

tickets.title: Create base layout and design system components
tickets.description: Extract reusable components from Thirtyspace design system. Buttons, inputs, badges, sidebar. Style with Tailwind. Export from src/components/ui/.

tickets.title: Build authentication flow
tickets.description: Create AuthPage component. Login, register, forgot password forms. Form validation with react-hook-form. JWT auth flow. Redirect logic. Ponytail: no social auth, add when requested.

tickets.title: Implement customer home dashboard
tickets.description: Create CustomerHomePage. Hero section, featured products, quick actions. Mobile responsive. Data from mock API. Ponytail: no real API integration, add when backend ready.

tickets.title: Build product catalog and detail pages
tickets.description: Create ProductCatalogPage and ProductDetailPage. Grid/list views. Filters. Add-to-cart functionality. Ponytail: no search, add when requested.
acceptance_criteria: Product detail page shows all fields

tickets.title: Implement shopping cart and checkout flow
tickets.description: Create ShoppingCartPage, CheckoutPage, OrderSummaryPage. Cart state management. Checkout form with validation. Ponytail: no payment gateway, mock only.
acceptance_criteria: Cart page shows items, quantities, totals

tickets.title: Build order history and tracking
tickets.description: Create OrderHistoryPage and OrderTrackingPage. Status badges. Cancellation flow. Ponytail: no real-time updates, add when websockets available.

tickets.title: Implement admin dashboard and management
tickets.description: Create AdminDashboardPage, CustomerManagementPage, EventManagementPage. Data tables with sorting/filtering. Ponytail: no bulk actions, add when requested.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create App shell. Navigation bar. React Router setup. Route guards. 404 page. Ponytail: no lazy loading, add when bundle >500KB.
acceptance_criteria: Navbar shows correct items per role
